A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same REPA work. Text and rendered-page comparison support reliable matching of the methods, equations, tables, figures, and complete Appendices A–M despite shifted pagination.

before.justification: v2 reports original REPA generation experiments, representation analyses, and ablations, including ImageNet results in Section 4 and Appendix J and MS-COCO results in Appendix K.

after.justification: v3 retains these original experiments and their quantitative and qualitative outcomes in the main text and appendices.

M1.justification: The REPA objective, projection MLP, alignment targets, architectures, and inference procedures are unchanged in Section 3 and the implementation appendices.

E1.justification: Both versions retain ImageNet generation at 256×256 and 512×512, ImageNet representation evaluation, and MS-COCO text-to-image generation. Pretrained-encoder coverage is also unchanged.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is identical in the corresponding experiments, including the DiT/SiT comparisons and ImageNet and MS-COCO benchmark tables (Tables 3, 4, 11, and 12).

E3.justification: Splits, training budgets, model configurations, metrics, sample counts, samplers, and guidance settings are unchanged. Figure 8's expanded caption clarifies the existing CKNNA comparison already described in v2 Section 4.4.

E4.justification: The encoder, alignment-depth, objective, and regularization-weight ablations remain unchanged, as do timestep analyses and Appendix L's feature visualizations. The expanded Figure 8 caption adds no experiment or analysis.

E5.justification: Both versions retain the same point-estimate reporting without added repeated-run counts, seed information, confidence intervals, error bars, or significance tests.

E6.justification: Numerical results, plotted findings, and qualitative samples are unchanged. Examples include FID 7.9 at 400K iterations without guidance in Table 3, FID 1.42 with guidance interval in Table 4, and MS-COCO SDE FID 4.14 in Table 12.

T1.justification: The diffusion and stochastic-interpolant formulations, REPA equations, and CKA/CKNNA definitions remain unchanged in Sections 2–3 and Appendices A and C. No mathematical assumptions, derivations, or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution statements, and conclusion retain the same scientific claims about representation alignment, faster diffusion-transformer training, and improved generation quality.

C2.justification: Figure 8's added statement about alignment across target representations repeats the interpretation already present in v2 Section 4.4. Mechanistic explanations and Appendix M's limitations and future directions are unchanged.

D1.justification: The reproducibility statement changes from promising a future implementation and checkpoint release to reporting their release. Existing access links, hyperparameters, hardware information, and implementation details remain unchanged; the PDFs alone do not verify the released artifacts.

R1.justification: The cited works and research positioning in Section 5 and Appendix I are unchanged. The bibliography matches after accounting for whitespace and pagination.

P1.justification: v3 expands Figure 8's caption, updates the reproducibility statement and publication header, adds an author affiliation, and inserts acknowledgments. The scientific narrative and section organization otherwise remain intact.

P2.justification: Figure 8's caption is lengthened, the author block and headers change, and acknowledgments cause bibliography reflow. The plots, table structures, diagrams, and qualitative image panels are unchanged.

improvement.justification: v3 modestly improves reproducibility information by reporting code and checkpoints as released, and makes Figure 8 more self-contained. The scientific method, evidence, and limitations remain unchanged, so the benefit is limited to documentation and reported resource availability.
